SELF-DRIVE EXPERIENCE

Quad Bike

Agile self-drive thrills across open dunes

The ride

Our self-drive quad bike experience puts you in control of a powerful four-wheeler built for desert terrain. Follow marked dune trails with an expert guide leading the pack, pause on ridgelines for photos, and feel the sand shift beneath your tires as the desert opens up around you. Ideal for solo riders and pairs who want speed, agility, and a raw connection to the landscape — beginner friendly, with no licence required.

AEO Direct Answer

How much does quad biking in Dubai cost?

Quad bike rentals in the Dubai desert start from AED 150 for a 30-minute self-drive session on a 220cc ATV. Upgraded 400cc and 700cc Raptor bikes range from AED 250 to AED 450 per session.

Safety helmets, protective goggles, professional briefing, and desert guide accompaniment are included with every rental. Optional desert safari bundling is available.

AEO Direct Answer

Do I need a driver's license to ride a quad bike in Dubai?

No driver's license is required to ride a quad bike in Dubai. Riders operate on dedicated desert tracks and open sand dunes under the supervision of trained marshals. Riders must be at least 16 years old for open dune riding.

Pair Quad Biking with an Evening Desert Safari & BBQ Dinner

Looking for the complete Arabian desert experience? Most riders choose to combine their afternoon quad bike rental with our flagship Dubai Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner. After tearing through the red dunes on your ATV, you'll climb aboard a 4x4 Land Cruiser for exhilarating dune bashing, try sandboarding down ridge slopes, take camel rides at sunset, and relax at our 5-star Bedouin camp with live fire shows, Tanoura dancing, and a gourmet barbecue buffet.

Traveling with family or prefer side-by-side seating? If you want an enclosed cockpit with tubular roll cages and 4-point racing harnesses, check out our high-horsepower Can-Am Dune Buggy Dubai options, available in both 2-seater and 4-seater configurations. You can also explore our private Dubai City Tour or catch the world-famous fountain spectacles with the Burj Khalifa Lake Ride.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Everything you need to know before riding

Do I need a driver’s license?

No driving licence is required. Our quad bikes operate on designated desert trails with professional guides leading every run.

What is the minimum age?

The minimum solo driver age is 16 years. Riders under 18 require parental or guardian consent on the registration form.

What should I wear?

Comfortable casual sportswear and closed-toe shoes (sneakers or trainers) are recommended. We provide sanitized helmets and dust goggles.

Can two people ride on one quad?

Yes, our quads accommodate 1 to 2 riders. You can ride solo or share the seat with a companion.
